You have the option to change the shipping address within 2 hours of purchase by accessing your order through the Account page.
Important to know:
Address changes are only possible within the same state due to sales tax variations — requests to change to a different state will be denied.
If you notice an error before the order ships, contact Support immediately to request an update.
Once the order has shipped, we cannot change the delivery address on our end. However, the tracking website may offer customizable options (like redirecting to a pickup location or updating the address) for a fee if you have a personal account with the courier.
